sample_retrieval.query: What are the rules regarding remote work and unregistered devices?

top_chunks.content: Remote Work Policy: Employees working remotely must connect via the corporate VPN. Unregistered personal devices are strictly prohibited from accessing internal databases.
Security Audit Guidelines: All endpoint devices must have updated antivirus signatures and active device encryption enabled before connecting.
IT Support Procedures: Requests for new laptop hardware or BYOD authorization must be submitted through the internal IT portal.
